steps.title: Every column with *
steps.prompt:
The star ( * ) means 'every column'.
Here we open the whole sale_items table and take every column it has.
steps.memory_trick: * = all the columns, in table order.

steps.title: Read the id column
steps.prompt:
SELECT chooses the COLUMNS you see.
Ask for just the id column from the sale_items table.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items;
hints: FROM names the table you read from.
steps.memory_trick: You get back only the column you name.

steps.prompt:

Here we ask for id and sale_id together.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id, sale_id FROM sale_items;
hints: Write: SELECT id, sale_id FROM sale_items;
steps.memory_trick: A comma says 'and also show me this'.

steps.title: Three columns
steps.prompt: More columns, same idea - just keep adding commas.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id, sale_id, product_id FROM sale_items;
hints: Write: SELECT id, sale_id, product_id FROM sale_items;
